description: Canonical Sense360 PoE room bundle SKU matrix (BUNDLE-SKU-MATRIX-001). Sellable customer-facing room kit SKUs, distinct from board SKUs (config/hardware-catalog.json) and from firmware config strings (config/firmware-combination-matrix.json, config/webflash-builds.json). This file is documentation / planning only: it does not add product YAMLs, WebFlash wrappers, firmware builds, artifacts, releases, or stable promotions. See docs/sense360-room-bundles.md.

rules.identical_hardware_is_one_bundle_sku: Two bundles that declare the same included_board_skus and the same firmware target are one physical bundle SKU with several recommended rooms, never two products. Enforced by tests/test_room_bundle_skus.py.
rules.commercial_identity_is_owned_by_sot: bundle_name mirrors the SOT record; this repository never mints or renames a commercial bundle identity.

bundles.notes: Default stable PoE bathroom bundle. The likely firmware config target Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ is the existing Release-One stable WebFlash build (see config/webflash-builds.json). No LED in this bundle; LED variant is gauntlet-gated.

Kitchen bundle pairs the AirIQ air-quality module (S360-210) with RoomIQ. Release history: promoted to stable v1.0.6 (2026-06-09) under owner risk-acceptance waiver HW-AIRIQ-WAIVER-2026-06 and owner declaration HW-RELEASE-001 (docs/hw-release-001.md); republished as v1.0.9 in the 2026-07-06 security rebuild; then DELIBERATELY DEMOTED to the preview channel by PR #834 (2026-07-16: the owner waiver is not hardware verification and must not cut a stable build), upheld by the owner decision of 2026-07-28 (SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001). Current truth: config/webflash-builds.json and config/product-catalog.json declare Ceiling-POE-AirIQ-RoomIQ preview v1.0.10 (release_state metadata-ready-unpublished), moved from v1.0.9 by SENSE360-REVIEW-RELEASE-001 because the published v1.0.9 release predates PR #875; the published GitHub Release v1.0.9 and its -stable.bin asset remain immutable and available, and the WebFlash PRESENTATION of that published v1.0.9 build is preview so its served presentation matches the recorded channel. Nothing is published at v1.0.10: the declaration is metadata-ready-unpublished and the only asset that exists for this config remains the v1.0.9 -stable.bin. Promotion to production is GATED on the owner-authored R-D4 bench attestation (G11; EXC-AIRIQ-PROMOTION-GATE-001 in the SOT SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001 charter) — waivers, compiles, scanner passes and served-state observation do not satisfy it, the attestation is never machine-written, and the channel change itself is owner-only. The prior waivers HW-AIRIQ-WAIVER-2026-06 and HW-S360-410-WAIVER-2026-06 remain the recorded risk-acceptance history; G1-G7 remain satisfied by the shipped build surfaces. Kit / customer visibility is UNCHANGED: the bundle stays hidden / not buyable / never the customer default (OD-SOT-009, docs/standing-invariants.md).

Bedroom bundle is the smallest RoomIQ-only PoE bundle. Release history: promoted to stable v1.0.5 (2026-06-08) under owner risk-acceptance waiver HW-S360-410-WAIVER-2026-06 — an owner decision, NOT hardware verification: S360-410 schematic_status stays cataloged_unverified and the remaining PoE bench / isolation evidence was waived, not measured; republished as v1.0.8 in the 2026-07-06 security rebuild. Current truth: config/webflash-builds.json declares Ceiling-POE-RoomIQ stable v1.0.8, config/product-catalog.json status production, and WebFlash serves it on the stable channel. The former G1-G7 gates are satisfied by the shipped build surfaces (top-level product YAML, catalog row, full compile, WebFlash wrapper, artifact name, config/webflash-builds.json stable row v1.0.8, release notes); the G8 evidence gates were resolved by the waiver as release blockers while the underlying evidence remains outstanding (RoomIQ on-device flash verification is not yet done; the pending owner R-D4 bench attestation applies to this build under the batch standard EXC-V107-V108-BATCH-INCONSISTENCY-001 in the SOT charter). Kit / customer visibility is UNCHANGED: the bundle stays hidden / not buyable / never the customer default (OD-SOT-009, docs/standing-invariants.md).

Hallway / landing bundle: RoomIQ + LED status ring on Core + PoE PSU. SENSE360-CANONICALISATION-001 PR 06 (OD-SOT-006): consolidated with the former S360-KIT-LIVING-P, which declared the identical board set and the identical firmware target. SOT owns commercial bundle identity and holds one record for this hardware (bundle id hallway-landing-poe, SKU S360-KIT-CORRIDOR-P, name 'Sense360 Hallway / Landing Bundle — PoE'); the SOT freeze baseline records S360-KIT-LIVING-P as deliberately absent. Living room is retained as a recommended room, never as a second product. Identical supplied hardware is one physical bundle SKU with several recommended rooms, so the duplicate living-room record is removed rather than renamed. Commercial name, status, visibility and buyability come from SOT only; this record is the technical join from bundle SKU to firmware target and asserts no availability. Same LED preview-gating as before: LED stays preview-only until the preview-to-stable gauntlet closes (S360-300-BENCH-001, WF-HW-TEST-001, WF-HW-TEST-003, RELEASE-007). Not promoted here; nothing becomes visible, buyable or customer-default.
